notes.title: Windows 10 Issues
notes.notes:
It's become apparent that running Casino Inc on Windows 10 is not displaying the Advertising map view correctly (all blue) and there may be some graphics cards getting Direct X errors and map display problems.

We made the announcement that it worked on Windows 10, after re-testing it following a Windows 10 update and being able to play it.

Unfortunately we are unable to directly fix any problems as this is a very old product and we don't have the source code/assets for it.

Sorry for any inconvenience caused and we hope that those who can, continue to enjoy this great game.

Thank you

notes.title: Casino Inc Working on Windows 10 ( without the Windows 10 Anniversary Update)
notes.notes:
Casino Inc is now working on Windows 10. 
Please note though the new Windows 10 Anniversary update now stops Casino Inc working on Windows 10.
We are looking at this issue, but without the original source code, it looks unlikely that this will be resolved

Thanks to everyone who has posted about this.

notes.title: The Management Expansion Pack Added. Free.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]A free addition to the game is now available![/b][/h1]

[b]The Management Expansion Pack.[/b]

You've already made a fortune running your empire in Casino. Inc - and now here's the chance to have even more fun with "The Management" Expansion Pack.

[h1]The new features are:-[/h1]
[list]
[*]3 New Cities for you to experience.
[*]A Sandbox mode which allows you to continue playing the new cities and the old cities after completing all the objectives.
[*]New Attractions, including Jackpot Slots, Punch Bags, Shooting Galleries and Cocktail Bars.
[*]New Casino Themes to choose, including Polar's, Centurions and Cutthroats.
[*]New Convention types, including Zombies and Hippies.
[*]New Game Features, including Hitmen with bombs!
